user.title: Set up your family
user.description: Your HA account becomes the owner. Templates add editable, unlinked placeholders; they do not grant access. Connect Telegram later in settings.

modules.description: Enable the modules your family needs. Settings and family data stay in Home Assistant across updates.

menu_options.member: Add or edit a family member

member.title: Family member
member.description: Select a member to edit, or add a new person.

edit_member.title: Add or edit a family member
edit_member.description: Choose a name, role and optional Home Assistant account. Telegram can be linked later.

data.name: Name
data.aliases: Other names and grammatical forms (one per line)

general.description: Optional pantry reminders go privately to linked parents after 09:00 in the household time zone, once per item revision. Only recorded dates from today through the lead window are included; no expired backlog or stock changes. This is a reminder to check the item, not a food-safety assessment. School preparation reminders also require this global switch; each recipient must separately subscribe themselves for a child in the School card. They use the household time zone and do not create tasks or automatically start routines or devices.
general.title: Household preferences

data.name: Household name
data.daily_penalty_cap: Maximum automatic negative points per person per day
data.pantry_expiry_reminders: Remind parents about recorded pantry expiry dates
data.pantry_expiry_days: Days before the recorded date (0 = that day only; 0–30)
data.school_preparation_days_before: School-day lead (0 = same day, 1 = day before)
data.school_preparation_time: Reminder time in the household time zone (HH:MM)

alarm_device.title: Wake-up siren
alarm_device.description: Assign a dedicated wake-up siren, never a fire or security alarm. Strict alarms renew sound until the member answers. Check the volume physically; HA state does not prove audible sound. Disabling removes the binding and stops sound started by Family Assistant.

data.confirmed: I confirm this device may be used repeatedly as a wake-up alarm

telegram.title: Connect your own Telegram bot
telegram.description: Create your own bot with @BotFather → /newbot and paste its token here. Do not reuse a bot already polled by another integration. An existing webhook is never removed automatically. Leave the token empty to keep the saved one. To disable, turn off the switch.

telegram_wait.title: Send the one-time enrollment code
telegram_wait.description:
Add your bot to the family group and send the command below, or open the personal link and press Start. Then press Submit here. The code expires in 15 minutes. No ID-discovery bot is needed.

{instruction}

telegram_confirm.title: Confirm the detected chat

data.confirmed: I confirm this is the correct chat or person

conversation.title: Language model and fallback
conversation.description: Optional: messages and a limited role-filtered family context go to the servers you configure. First enable Conversation under Household preferences. Enter the Ollama base URL and exact installed model name (see /api/tags or ollama list). Both servers are checked before saving. A model has no internet without Search. HTTP is unencrypted; use it only on a trusted LAN/VPN, never expose Ollama directly. Leave keys blank to preserve them. Model-generated mutations require confirmation.

data.allow_http: Allow unencrypted HTTP on a trusted network

search.title: Internet search (SearXNG)
search.description: Enter your own SearXNG base URL. Enable json in search.formats in SearXNG settings.yml. Saving tests a public query. Search sends only a phrase grounded in the current request, not stored family records. Results are filtered for internal addresses and treated as untrusted snippets. Full article fetching is not available yet.

data.allow_http: Allow unencrypted HTTP on a trusted network

presence_sources.title: Presence sources
presence_sources.description: Display-only, optional. Select a registered person or device_tracker you may read. Each HA-linked member consents on their own card. Changing the source revokes old consent. No history or coordinates are stored.

presence_source_review.title: Review presence source
presence_source_review.description: Member: {member}. Action: {action} (enable = assign, remove = remove source). Entity: {entity}. Source revision: {binding_revision}; member revision: {member_revision}. Maximum age: {max_age_seconds} seconds. This changes only the source binding, not consent.

digests.title: Digest schedule
digests.description: Set the household policy for private morning, evening and weekly digests. All kinds are off by default and use the household time zone. Each current family member must separately consent for themselves in their Digest card; the owner cannot subscribe anyone else.

digest_policy_review.title: Review digest schedule
digest_policy_review.description: Time zone: {timezone}. Morning: {morning} at {morning_time}. Evening: {evening} at {evening_time}. Weekly: {weekly} on day {weekly_weekday} at {weekly_time} (Monday = 0, Sunday = 6). This changes only the household policy; it does not subscribe family members.

data.confirmed: I confirm this exact digest schedule

recipes.title: Your Mealie recipe source
recipes.description: Optional Mealie 3 connection. Enter the base URL (without /api) and a token from Mealie → User profile → API tokens. Family Assistant only reads recipes; use a separate least-privileged account. Parents explicitly review recipe data before creating a menu draft. No dietary profiles are sent. HTTPS is preferred. Blank token preserves the stored token only for the same URL; disabling does not erase it unless Clear token is selected.

data.allow_http: Allow unencrypted HTTP (trusted local network only)

mikrotik.title: Read your MikroTik inventory
mikrotik.description: Optional RouterOS 7 HTTPS REST connection. Enable MikroTik in Household preferences too. Use your own dedicated account with read and rest-api only for inventory, not the built-in read group (it has extra powers). This step makes no router changes. A custom CA certificate may be pasted below; verification is never disabled. Do not paste a private key. Passwords stay in local HA options. Blank preserves the password; changing server or username requires entering it again. Optional writes need a dedicated account with read,write,rest-api. Write is a broad RouterOS policy; this integration exposes only selected lease plans. Specify and verify the HA host and your administration device as protected MACs before enabling. Saving these settings makes no router changes; each plan requires separate confirmation.

data.management_confirmed: I verified these management devices and authorize only reviewed network plans

network_target.message: The selected lease is missing, inactive or unsupported. Refresh the inventory.

network_conflict.message: The lease identity, IP or server is ambiguous or changed. No further change was applied.

network_protected.message: This target is protected or has no valid unicast MAC.

network_subnet.message: The IP, DHCP server and interface subnet could not be verified.

network_readonly.message: Router writes are disabled in connection settings.

network_recovery_consent.message: Confirm DHCP recovery: rollback of conversion removes the new reservation; dynamic leases return through DHCP renewal, not an exact restoration.

network_confirmation.message: Review the selected records and explicitly confirm this plan.

network_readback.message: The router read-back did not match the requested result. Check the plan; do not assume success.

network_management_required.message: Specify and confirm protected HA-host and administration-device MACs before allowing writes.

network_stale.message: The inventory is too old. Read the router again before preparing a plan.

network_busy.message: Another network plan is still running. Wait for its verified result.

network_time_window.message: Use increasing daily windows, such as 08:00-22:00. Split an overnight window between two days.

network_clock.message: Router clock or time zone differs from this household. Check its clock/NTP before changing schedules.

network_kid_membership.message: The entire profile membership must match the explicitly selected devices. Disabled, dynamic or changed members require review.

network_kid_unmanaged.message: The owner must explicitly adopt this child's RouterOS profile and devices first.

network_timer_required.message: A verified RouterOS 7.16+ expiry/startup timer is required. Temporary access was not safely enabled.

insufficient_points.message: Not enough available points. Existing requests reserve their cost.

reward_expired.message: This privilege request expired. Submit a new request.

confirmation_required.message: Confirm that shared confirmed events may be visible to other Home Assistant users.

media_invalid.message: The photo could not be verified. Use a static JPEG, PNG or WebP.

media_too_large.message: The photo exceeds the file or image-size limit.

media_unavailable.message: Could not confirm the photo operation. Retry the same reviewed action.

quota_exceeded.message: The private photo quota is full. Unattached uploads expire automatically.

confirm.title: Resume after the failed backup release
confirm.description: A backup finished or failed, but Family Assistant could not release every write lock. Changes and reloads remain paused to protect consistency. This action retries only the remaining locks from that backup; it does not restore an archive, delete data or interrupt an active backup. Continue to retry.

error.backup_unavailable: Some locks could not be released. Changes remain paused. Check integration health and retry after the underlying failure is resolved.

abort.stale_recovery: This recovery is no longer current. The locks may already have been released. Reopen Repairs if a new issue appears.

telegram_attention.title: Telegram needs attention
telegram_attention.description: Check the Family Assistant health panel and the Telegram options. The token may be revoked, another poller may use the same bot, or a webhook may exist. Family Assistant does not remove other applications' webhooks.

delivery_attention.title: A notification needs review
delivery_attention.description: Some notifications failed or have an uncertain delivery result. Telegram may already have accepted a message before the connection timed out. Family Assistant will not blindly resend it. Review delivery details in the health panel.

school_retention_attention.title: School reminder history needs review
school_retention_attention.description: School reminder storage reached its limit, contains inconsistent retained records, or the clock moved into retired history. New reminders for retired dates remain blocked. Review counts-only diagnostics and notification delivery; resolve uncertain results explicitly. Do not clear stored history to force a resend.

digest_retention_attention.title: Digest retention needs review
digest_retention_attention.description: The retained digest marker or event limit was reached, so new digests are paused. Review digest delivery health and resolve pending, uncertain or failed notifications. This Repair contains counts only and does not identify recipients or messages.

frontend_resource_attention.title: Dashboard card resource needs review
frontend_resource_attention.description: Automatic Family Assistant card resource setup could not finish safely. Lovelace may use YAML resources, a manual Family Assistant resource may already exist, multiple integration-owned records may exist, or Lovelace may not be ready. Follow the Family Assistant frontend resource setup guide. This Repair contains no external resource URL or family data.
